This is a page listing loot to be found in The Stormwind Stockade. For information about the instance itself, see Stormwind Stockade (Classic).

The Stormwind Royal Guard is an elite unit of the Stormwind Army that serves as the personal guards of the House of Wrynn, the ruling dynasty of the Kingdom of Stormwind. They are charged with protecting the ruling monarch of Stormwind and their family, and will often accompany members of the royal family (especially the king) on journeys or expeditions.
The Strange Lockbox is located in four locations. They contained items for the druid water form quest.
Stormwind Archmages are humans found in Silithus during the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj opening event.

The Strange Object can be found in the Cenarion Thicket of Terokkar Forest.
The following is a list of the quests that give reputation points with the Stormwind faction.

Two Stormwind Captains accompany Bolvar Fordragon at Fordragon Hold in Dragonblight, but both are slain in the climatic battle in which Grand Apothecary Putress lets his plague loose on the Alliance, Horde, and Scourge forces. At least one captain suffered a direct collision with a plague barrel and collapsed dead almost instantly.
The Stormwright's Shelf is located above and to the west of the Makers' Perch in Sholazar Basin. It's usually raining in this area.

Strand of the Ancients Mark of Honor was a reward for completing a game at the Strand of the Ancients. Players of the winning faction received three, and players of the losing faction just one. Strand of the Ancients Veteran was a player vs. player achievement earned for winning 100 battles in the Strand of the Ancients battleground.

The Strange Gong can be found at the entrance of Zul'Aman. This device will allow you to break the seals and open the door. During The Burning Crusade, this started by talking to Harrison Jones and required five players hitting the gong to break the seals. In Cataclysm, only Vol'jin and one single player are required.
Stormtrooper is a player vs. player achievement earned for killing 5 flag carriers in a single Eye of the Storm battle.
Stormy Assassin is a player vs. player achievement earned for getting 5 honorable kills at each base in a single Eye of the Storm battle.
Stormwind Valiants are the valiant challengers of the alliance faction Stormwind.

Stormwind Love Boats are small rowboats that appear in Stormwind during the Love is in the Air event. They originate at the dock west of the Trade District at , and travel around the canals, eventually stopping at the dock east of Cathedral Square (). All of the boats follow the same route. It is a clickable vehicle, designed for two players to board it. It can be boarded at any point, and can be left through the standard vehicle interface. Once the two players board it, a love heart forms above each of their heads. Upon returning to the dock, the boat despawns, and anyone still in the boat is returned to the dock.

Stormwind Spears are located on the ground in Seafarer's Tomb in Kelp'thar Forest or can be looted from Gilblin Scavengers.
Stormvine is an herb that grows near Nordrassil, though in-game it can also be found in certain parts of Vashj'ir. Silky Moths prefer to feed on Stormvine nectar.
Stormwind Lockers can be found around Seafarer's Tomb in Kelp'thar Forest.

Stormwind Infantry Belt is a quest reward from Lions for Lambs.

Stormwind Writs of Commendation are sold by Zen'Vorka at Malfurion's Breach in the Molten Front for .

Stormwind Infantry are human footmen that can be found in Northshire Valley. They have been sent to defend the valley from the recent Blackrock clan invasion there. They can be found to the west of the abbey, attempting to fend off attacking Blackrock Worgs sent by Kurtok the Slayer. Some have been ambushed and injured by the Goblin Assassins in the area.
Stormwind Investigators are humans found roaming around Westfall, helping Horatio Laine in his investigations and also inside the Alliance version of the Deadmines.
Stormwind Defenders are humans found inside the Alliance version of the Deadmines.
Stormwind Soldiers are human soldiers found throughout Vashj'ir.
Stormwind Stockade Guild Run is a guild achievement that is awarded for defeating the final boss of the Stormwind Stockade instance while in a guild group.
The Strange Smelling Boots were a quest reward from Scout's Dishonor during the Cataclysm beta.
Stormwind Seals are humans scattered around the Kelp'thar Forest.

Straight Six is an achievement that is awarded for deactive six Empyreal Focuses within 10 seconds of each other and defeating Elegon in the Mogu'shan Vaults raid instance.

Stormwind Footmen are soldiers from Stormwind who fought under Jaina's banner during the Purge of Dalaran. They are led by Lieutenant Corwin. Occasionally, they would attack Displaced Sunreavers.

You'll soon find out

Man-eating stranglethorn vines derive their name from their native environment: the dangerous, mist-filled jungles of Stranglethorn Vale. Stranglethorn vines are a crucial part of the jungle ecosystem, acting as a counterweight to some of the region's larger predators. Blending in with other types of less-dangerous flora, they often lay in wait, concealed for several days, until prey approaches into range. The plant consists mostly of large, trunk-like stalks covered in semi-translucent bark. Its entire length is dotted with numerous clusters of leafy, thorn-covered vines that almost manage to conceal a pattern of strange, swollen bulges protruding from various places along the main stalk. Stress testing is the act of stressing various parts of software by putting heavy and increased load on inputs (large graphics, more operations, more users, etc.), constrained or reduced resources (low bandwidth, low memory, low storage, etc.), or operating on below recommended hardware (slow CPU, slow hard drive, etc). Stress test invites are different than beta invites, and players invited for the stress test are typically only invited to the stress test and not the beta as well. During the original World of Warcraft stress test, players that won the stress test contest were also invited into the closed beta test.

Stratholme Holy Water is a stackable item that when used does 438 to 562 damage to undead within a 10 yard radius. It is used in two quests: Houses of the Holy and Collection of Goods. While its usefulness in regular Undead instances like Stratholme cannot be denied, it really shines as an assist during the third phase of the Nefarian fight, in which upwards of forty undead constructs spawn and rush the group. The Water is generally used by the warriors who run out to intercept the constructs, as they are apt to have the most constructs around them, so they get the most benefit out of them for the raid.

The Stromgarde Defenders are the force protecting Stromgarde. They use both infantry and cavalry units. Knights support the warriors when dealing with the enemy, especially ogre and Syndicate forces. The Stromgarde Snipers Company, made up of Dwarven Rifleman troops, often aids them with covering fire. Captain Dathanor Cromwell commands the infantry unit, while Captain Ariana Thesslocke leads the cavalry unit. Grizzled Jopp is also a member.
The Stromgarde Snipers Company often aids the Stromgarde Defenders. The Dwarven Rifleman troops provide covering fire and attack select units at range.

Strom'kar, the Warbreaker is the artifact two-handed sword used by arms warriors in World of Warcraft: Legion. It previously belonged to King Thoradin, the barbarian warlord who first united humanity and founded the nation of Arathor, and was lost while it was being used to subdue the C'Thraxxi monstrosity, Zakajz the Corruptor, in a forgotten tomb beneath Tirisfal Glades.
